protocol.title: A Microfluidic Multiplex Sorter for Strain Development
protocol.platform: Droplet-digital microfluidics with multiplex electrostatic sorting
protocol.objective: Multiplex droplet-based high-throughput screening and sorting of genome-shuffled diastatic yeast by two fluorescence thresholds of glucoamylase activity, followed by maltodextrin growth screening and beverage fermentation evaluation

layers: Chromium co-planar electrode layer on glass (layer i)
SU-8 5 dielectric layer, 7 um thick (layer ii)
PDMS channel layer, 75 um height, 100 um width for 30 pL droplets (layer iii)
sections: Multiplex electrostatic sorter with three outlets (SC1, SC2, WC)

electrodes.sorting_electrode_1: SE1 (deflects to SC1, high-fitness gate GT1)
electrodes.sorting_electrode_2: SE2 (deflects to SC2, mid-fitness gate GT2)

reagents.surfactant: PEG fluoro-surfactant (Ran Biotechnologies) 2% w/v in HFE7500
reagents.cell_media: YPD broth (yeast peptone dextrose), 2x concentration buffered at pH 7.5

fluorescent_substrate.name: 4-methylumbelliferyl-alpha-D-glucopyranoside (4-MUG-a)
fluorescent_substrate.notes: Validated for glucoamylase activity at neutral pH; distinguishable signal vs negative control IY1 at pH 7.5

surface_blocker.purpose: Reduce protein adsorption to droplet interface and PDMS walls

maltodextrin_media.composition: 2 g/L yeast extract, 4 g/L bacto peptone, 20 g/L maltodextrin
maltodextrin_media.purpose: Post-HTS growth screening; evaluates starch utilisation capacity

synthetic_beverage_media.composition: 125 g/L maltose, 60 g/L maltodextrin, 1 mL ethanol, 1.25 mL 50% glycerol (in water), 3 mL 85% lactic acid, 2 g/L yeast extract, 6.4 g/L bactopeptone, pH 5.9, 25 mg/mL chloramphenicol
synthetic_beverage_media.purpose: Lab-scale beverage fermentation evaluation mimicking industrial conditions

reagents.negative_control: IY1 (non-diastatic S. cerevisiae STA1-, does not secrete glucoamylase)
reagents.positive_control: IRY1 (recombinant S. cerevisiae with heterologous glucoamylase gene)

genome_shuffling.method: Self-mating (genome shuffling via sporulation and mating)
genome_shuffling.sporulation_medium: 1 g/L yeast extract, 10 g/L potassium acetate, 0.5 g/L glucose
genome_shuffling.incubation_after_spores: 50 uL YPD 2% glucose, 30 C overnight; then 5 mL 2% YPD, 30 C overnight
genome_shuffling.regulatory_note: Non-GMO mutagenesis technique; compliant with agro-food industry regulatory requirements

droplet_sizes.reason: Highest glucoamylase fluorescence signal (~3 a.u. for IDY1 at 48h) and fastest throughput

droplet_generation.collection: PCR tube with 50 uL of 2% fluorosurfactant in HFE7500

steps.name: Cell suspension preparation
steps.organism: IDY1 or IDY2 (this file encodes IDY1 arm)
steps.preculture: Overnight in YPD broth at 30 C / 200 rpm
steps.wash_steps: 3x PBS wash by centrifugation; resuspend in 2x YPD broth pH 7.5
steps.notes: OD600 adjusted for Poisson lambda=0.3 for each droplet size. BSA added to reduce surface adsorption.

steps.name: Fluorescent substrate preparation
steps.notes: Co-encapsulated 1:1 with cell suspension to yield 2 mM 4-MUG-a per droplet. Neutral pH preserves cell viability.

steps.name: Single-cell encapsulation in 30 pL droplets
steps.operation: T-junction co-flow encapsulation (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.notes: Poisson-based single-cell encapsulation (lambda=0.3). Droplet generation monitored by Fiji (ImageJ).

steps.name: Off-chip incubation for glucoamylase activity development
steps.collection_tube: PCR tube with 50 uL 2% fluorosurfactant in HFE7500
steps.imaging_purpose: Cell growth (bright-field cell counting) and glucoamylase activity (4-MUG-a fluorescence)
steps.fluorescence_metric: CTDF (corrected total droplet fluorescence) calculated from Fiji ROI density integration
steps.notes: 48 h selected as optimal: highest fluorescence and cell growth plateau for 30 pL droplets. Incubation in the dark.

steps.name: Droplet re-injection and flow-through fluorescence detection
steps.operation: re-injection into sorter (abstracted as mix in BioScript)
steps.detection_method: In-line optical fiber fluorescence (ex 470 nm LED, em 450 nm bandpass)
steps.histogram_gating: Gaussian fluorescence distribution used to set GT1 and GT2 thresholds
steps.notes: Fluorescence intensity measured by in-house automation software to route each droplet to SE1, SE2, or WC.

steps.name: Multiplex sorting - high-fitness gate (GT1)
steps.operation: electrostatic sorting (abstracted as detect + if/else in BioScript)

steps.name: Multiplex sorting - mid-fitness gate (GT2)
steps.key_finding: Mid-level sorted strains (IDY1-M23, IDY2-M9) showed superior fermentation performance vs high-level sorted strains; would have been missed by binary screening

steps.name: Colony recovery and plating
recovery_steps: Pipette top layer of oil emulsion from pipette tips at SC1 or SC2 outlets
Take 5 uL aliquots from sorted population
Pick 24 single colonies per gate (GT1 and GT2) for post-HTS analysis
Prepare glycerol freezer stocks from remaining emulsion (YPD broth overnight)

steps.name: Post-HTS maltodextrin growth screening
steps.preculture: YPD broth 48 h at 30 C / 300 rpm
steps.maltodextrin_media_composition: 2 g/L yeast extract, 4 g/L bacto peptone, 20 g/L maltodextrin
steps.measurement: OD600 at 24 h and 48 h (Tecan Sunrise microplate reader)
steps.metric: Maltodextrin growth fold improvement = Mutant OD / Wild type OD

steps.name: Fermentation evaluation in synthetic beverage media
steps.vial: 6 mL mini vials sealed with rubber caps pierced with needles for gas exchange
steps.synthetic_media_composition: 125 g/L maltose, 60 g/L maltodextrin, 1 mL ethanol, 1.25 mL 50% glycerol, 3 mL 85% lactic acid, 2 g/L yeast extract, 6.4 g/L bactopeptone, pH 5.9, 25 mg/mL chloramphenicol
steps.mixing: 180 rpm for 5 min at start; then without agitation
steps.dry_biomass: Pellet cells; dry at 60 C overnight

metrics.primary: CO2 released per mg dry biomass (mg CO2/mg yeast)
metrics.secondary: Ethanol content normalised to dry biomass (mg ethanol/mL per mg yeast)

results.key_finding: Mid-level sorted strains outperformed high-level sorted strains in fermentation; attributed to balanced glucoamylase expression avoiding metabolic burden

design_efficiency_without_actuation.result: 100% droplets directed to WC regardless of droplet volume

sorting_efficiency_with_actuation.channel_difference: no significant difference between SC1 and SC2 efficiency

binary_vs_multiplex_comparison.sampling_overhead_vs_multiplex: at least 14x more strains needed for equivalent 95% confidence
binary_vs_multiplex_comparison.conclusion: Multiplex reduces sample size ~14x for post-analysis; avoids non-uniform exploration of fitness landscape

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Cell prep, genome shuffling, encapsulation, 48h incubation, re-injection, detection

basic_blocks.description: Dispose gt2Signal; begin post-HTS maltodextrin screening

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.description: Fermentation evaluation; two-phase heat; detect fermentSignal

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_13_j
basic_blocks.description: Dispose growthSignal, fermentSignal; NOP; experiment ends
